description: Every active process pursues the existing generic order-N Goal tree under a renewable integer lease. Approximate time and prediction-envelope departures trigger a graph-native, per-goal marginal-efficiency check-in without scalarisation.

rules.name: cs_attach_renewable_lease_to_selected_cognitive_process
rules.comment: The process owns a strict integer lease and clock. The situated evidence window is an evidence-unit span; check-ins are scheduled from receipt/evidence progress, never cognitive epochs.

rules.name: cs_follow_existing_goal_tree_to_arbitrary_depth
rules.comment: A subgoal is a Goal. Repeated fixpoint application therefore exposes every reachable order without a depth limit.

rules.name: cs_mint_one_pareto_dimension_per_reachable_goal
rules.comment: Every reachable Goal remains an independent Pareto dimension; effort changes its marginal rate but never weights or sums it with another goal.

rules.name: cs_adjust_async_daemon_cycle_quantum_from_supervisory_lease
rules.comment: The asynchronous host consumes a graph-authored rewrite quantum. A new supervisory lease publishes an immutable adjustment provenance node before changing the next quantum.
